'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is obtained by killing green [[Monsters|slimes]] in the dungeon or north of [[Sweet Home]] (during the morning). Green jelly is utilized for [[cooking]] and [[alchemy]], where its used to produce [[order solution]] and [[order extract]].

==Alchemy==
Green jelly can be decomposed to [[Order solution|solution]] and [[Order extract|extract]] with the [[hand mixer]] and any of the distillation cubes, respectively. Having unlocked [[Anatomy and Alchemy (Tech Tree)|Master of Alchemy]] produces one additional reagent at any workstation
